get.description:
Start Authorization Code + PKCE: state/verifier stay server-side, the browser goes to the AS page.

A registered web device (signed ``__Host-erp_device`` cookie) gets a device-bound login (14 §7.2).

"Who am I" + heartbeat (14 §16.1.4, §20); ``403 SUBSCRIPTION_RESTRICTED`` when locked out.

Cheap enough for a ~30 s heartbeat: the session and subscription state come
from Redis and the profile part is cached for 60 s (``SessionProfileService``).

post.description:
Tenant switch (14 §9): a fresh server-side code exchange for ``tenant_id``, the old session dies.

Cookie session + ``X-CSRF-Token`` only. The answer is ``GET /auth/session`` of the new
session and ``__Host-sid`` now points to it; the CSRF token of the old ``sid`` is dead —
fetch a new one (``GET /api/v1/auth/csrf``). The current tenant itself is a no-op (same
session, no cookie change). ``403 PERMISSION_DENIED`` — no active membership there;
``403 SUBSCRIPTION_RESTRICTED`` — that tenant is locked out (14 §16.1.2); in both cases the
current session stays as it was.
Telegram bot first, SMS fallback (14 §4.2); ``channel_used`` + ``TELEGRAM_NOT_LINKED`` warning.

``OTP_INVALID`` / ``OTP_EXPIRED`` / ``OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS`` (5 attempts per challenge).

``429 RATE_LIMITED`` — per-IP attempt limit or the per-phone daily cap of wrong codes (14 §12).
New password and/or PIN after a verified code; ``204`` — then a normal login (no tokens here).
15 §1.5 provisioning in one transaction, then the owner is logged in (``__Host-sid``).

get.description:
302 to Google; Google not configured / unavailable → 302 ``/login?error=google_auth_failed``.

``429 RATE_LIMITED`` past 30 starts / IP / 10 min (14 §12).
Known account → BFF login cookie; new account → ``/onboarding?method=google`` (BO-21 ①-Google).

post.description:
Android native Google Sign-In: verified ID token → one-time ``android-pos`` code.

The app redeems it at ``/oauth/token`` (``authorization_code`` + its ``code_verifier``).

202.description: Over the stock.writeoff limit — approval requested

503.description: EINVOICE_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE — the e-invoice operator did not answer

post.description:
Register this browser as the web device of a cash register (14 §7.2) — Owner/Manager.

BFF cookie session only. The current session is replaced by a device-bound one (sliding 14 d /
absolute 180 d): new ``__Host-sid`` and ``__Host-erp_device`` cookies; fetch a new CSRF token.

200.description: This browser is already that device

post.description:
Online PIN check on a registered device (14 §4.3, §12): "who pressed", never a token.

The device's session must be device-bound (``403 PERMISSION_DENIED reason=device_required``).

400.description: PIN_INVALID (params.reason=must_change_pin — the PIN must be set anew)

post.description:
End the PIN actor of this device session (SEC-05): cashier lock/switch, shift close, logout.

Idempotent; afterwards every ``/api/v1`` call needs a new online ``POST /auth/pin/verify``.
